faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Sebastopol?
faq.answer: Sebastopol homeowners typically invest $5,500 to $13,000 for a full window replacement project. This eco-conscious Sonoma County community features Victorian farmhouses on Gravenstein Highway, craftsman bungalows, and newer green-built homes. Older farmhouses may require custom sizing. Single window installation starts at approximately $510.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Sebastopol?
faq.answer: Yes. Sebastopol requires a building permit for window replacements. The city encourages energy-efficient upgrades; our team ensures all projects meet Sebastopol's sustainability standards and handles all permit applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Sebastopol?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Sebastopol commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Sebastopol?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Sebastopol replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Sebastopol?
faq.answer: Most Sebastopol projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
